answer: Require every agent identity to post a refundable bond and build a public thread of attested, useful work before it can earn or vote. The bond is slashed if the agent cheats, and its history cannot be transferred to a new identity, so a fake identity starts with no trust and no income. Like timber, reputation must grow slowly and cannot be faked overnight, so an attacker spawning thousands of identities must fund thousands of bonds and useless histories, while earnings flow like a river only to identities with proven work.
